title: The night tour in Barcelona was amazing!
text: First time I booked a night tour in Barcelona, even if it wasn't my first time visiting. Our guide, Xavi, was extremely knowledgeable and very proud of his city and his Catalunian origins. He made a very interesting speech while we were admiring this marvelous city, that spanned across centuries of history, local, Catalan and contemporary culture, arts, architecture and local anecdotes. I really recommend taking the tour at night, especially in August, not only for the pleasant breeze but also for the beauty of the monuments under the night lights. title: Fun evening activity for tired family
text: This bus ride tour was enjoyable, went with husband and three teenagers. Everyone was seated on the top level of the open-air bus, it was a very nice evening and the gentle breeze felt good. We had to wear earphones that they gave us to listen to our tour guide… (mine kept falling out which was annoying but the rest of our party seemed fine). Very fun seeing the Sangrada Familia but disappointing to see a large crane extended over one area (but tour guide says it is ALWAYS under construction.) title: Good tour, spotty audio
text:
The tour and guide were great. The guide shared lots of information and the tour locations were breathtaking. 

Unfortunately the speaker’s microphone kept cutting out and reconnecting, making it hard to keep up with the details she was sharing. 

I recommend this tour and I suggest to City Tour that you check your sound system connectivity.
author: Allie_T

title: Riding the bus was fun,...
text: Riding the bus was fun, saw lots but bus doesn’t stop so very few picture taking opportunities. Other tours probably better, much preferred the Tuk-tuk.
author: Gayle_S

title: Nice for the price
